period.note: Dates are planning targets only, NOT scheduled automations or actual publications.

purpose: Assess whether consistent Luka identity and a varied activity-driven feed can attract new followers, without making unproven causal claims after six posts.

baseline.source: pending user-provided Instagram Insights screenshot; do not infer or fabricate

metric_definitions.reach: unique accounts reached; if Insights supports
metric_definitions.nonfollower_reach: unique accounts not following; if Insights supports
metric_definitions.profile_follow_conversion: new follows / profile visits when both tracked in same window and denominator >0; observational, not attributed to one post
metric_definitions.engagement_per_reach: (saves + shares)/reach, with denominators from same post/window; do not compare against count of impressions
metric_definitions.followers_growth: followers_end - followers_start; not causal after 6-post sample

posts.theme: bookstore / an action, not a pose
posts.concept: Luka quietly examining an illustrated photo book in a small independent city bookshop; tactile ordinary moment; a tailored relaxed neutral tee shows athletic silhouette under clothing; camera off-axis, his attention on the open book; different from approved black-T-shirt alley portrait.
posts.caption: Went in to look around. Found a book I couldn't put down.\n\nDo you ever go into a bookshop without knowing what you're looking for?

reel_prototype.method: single source still with subtle 3.8% virtual camera zoom and blurred vertical background, no character or book animation
reel_prototype.notes: No video AI generations; character remains pixel source still to avoid identity drift. Blurred borders are intentional and not an outpaint.
reel_prototype.owner_feedback: Видео полностью статично, я могу использовать другой инструмент
reel_prototype.lesson: An MP4 of a still with pan/zoom is not actual image-to-video character animation. Do not label motion photo as actual AI video or publish as animated Luka. To animate, use cloud image-to-video with facial and hand-motion checking; connected Runway workspace did not expose video models on its free plan.
reel_prototype.next_candidate: Try browser-based Kling image-to-video free credits or PixVerse daily free credits; generated footage not yet tested, no publishing.

posts.concept: Coffee in the kitchen while doing something; relaxed, non-idealized lighting
Tennis warm-up or after-play, practical movement, credible body mechanics, no imitation of Cyrus image
Natural candid activity, different locale and wardrobe, sense of occasion not empty posing
Tasteful fitness/lifestyle, strong male body presentation without hypertrophy or copying a real person's identity

posts.format: carousel if independent images pass QC
posts.concept: Noir-influenced modern menswear in an original shoot with genuinely different angles and poses

prepublication_gate: visual identity checked against approved Luka reference
AI nature of account disclosed on profile; review Instagram platform label
record posted URL/time only when actual publication is confirmed

after_publication.capture: post URL, time, asset ID, caption version, 24h/72h views/reach/saves/shares/comments/profile visits/follows where available
after_publication.never_claim: published without a link/user confirmation; successful experiment on aesthetic reaction alone

constraints: no local software or user laptop computing
no auto-posting without explicit account access and confirmed permission
do not change Content Factory architecture
